idea-plugin.name: FishBook-X
idea-plugin.description:
FishBook-X — Read Novels in IDEA

Notice: This plugin is a fork of jogeen/FishBook (original author: jogeen, 2020). The original project targets the old IntelliJ Platform API; this fork adapts it to IDEA 2025.3.4 and adds new features. All original design and code belong to the original author.

What is FishBook?

A lightweight plugin that lets you read TXT novels directly in your IntelliJ IDEA side tool window.

Features (inherited from the original project)

  • 📖 Read TXT e-books in a dedicated tool window
  • 🔖 Auto-save reading progress (bookmark-like)
  • ⏭️ Page turning (previous/next/first/last)
  • 🔢 Custom page size

New in FishBook-X (added in this fork)

  • 🆕 Chapter detection & quick jump — auto-detects 第N章 / Chapter N / 序章 / 楔子 etc., and lets you jump straight to a chapter's first page from a dropdown.
  • 🆕 Remember last-read chapter — the chapter dropdown restores your last position after a restart.
  • 🆕 Keyboard page turning — press ← / → in the reader to flip pages.
  • 🆕 Performance rewrite — the book is now loaded into memory once with a BufferedReader; page turning is O(1).
  • 🆕 Modern platform APIs — migrated to Light Service, NotificationGroupManager, ContentFactory.getInstance(), compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3.4 (build 253.x).

How to Use

  1. Open Settings → Tools → FishBook Config
  2. Click 选择... to pick a TXT e-book file
  3. Set the page size (default: 10 lines per page)
  4. Click Apply
  5. Open the FishBook tool window on the right side
  6. Use the chapter dropdown to jump to any chapter

Chapter Detection

Supports common chapter formats:

  • 第N章 / 第N回 / 第N节 / 第N卷
  • Chapter N
  • 序章 / 楔子 / 尾声 / 番外

Credits & License

Original project: github.com/jogeen/FishBook

This fork: github.com/SagitTariuse/FishBook-X

idea-plugin.change-notes:
FishBook-X 2.0.2 (2026-09-28) — chapter detection fixes

  • 🐛 Fix: chapter list was truncated from a certain chapter onwards
    • Affected books include 凡人, where the heading style switches mid-book from 第一千九百九十九章 to 第两千章. The Chinese-numeral character set was missing 两, so every chapter from that point on failed to match — 447 of 2463 chapters disappeared and the dropdown appeared to stop at 第十一卷.
    • Fix: added 两 to the character set.
  • 🐛 Fix: chapter headings indented with full-width spaces were not detected
    • Root cause: Java's \s matches ASCII whitespace only, not U+3000 (full-width space) — which is what most Chinese TXT novels use for indentation. Also, String.trim() only strips ASCII whitespace, so detected chapter names kept their 　　 prefix.
    • Fix: match U+3000 / U+00A0 explicitly in all chapter patterns, and switch trim() to strip().
  • ✨ Support spaced headings such as 第 2000 章 — whitespace is now tolerated both after 第 and before the chapter measure (章/回/节/卷/部/集/篇).

FishBook-X 2.0.1 (2026-06-12) — bug fix

  • 🐛 Fix: chapter dropdown jumped to first chapter after page turning
    • Root cause: loadChapters() was called on every page turn, and cbChapter.setSelectedIndex(...) fired the chapter's ActionListener, which recursively called turnPage() and reset the dropdown to the first chapter.
    • Fix: split the UI initialization into firstInitUi() (runs only once) and the page-turn hot path. Added a suppressChapterEvent reentry guard around all setSelectedIndex calls so the chapter dropdown no longer triggers recursive page jumps.
  • 🐛 Fix: chapter dropdown did not update when turning pages
    • Root cause: Chapter did not override equals(), so JComboBox.setSelectedItem(newChapter) could not find the matching item already inside the dropdown (it relies on equals to look up the model). The call returned silently and the dropdown display did not change.
    • Fix: rewrote syncChapterByPage() to compute the matched chapter's index first, then call setSelectedIndex(matchedIndex) with the reentry guard. Index-based selection is independent of the Chapter.equals() behavior, so the dropdown now updates reliably.
  • 🎨 Chapter dropdown width: 210px → 294px (~15 → ~21 Chinese chars) so longer chapter titles (e.g. 第 1234 章 长长的标题文字示例) fit in the closed dropdown.

FishBook-X 2.0.0 (2026-06-11) — first fork release

This is a fork of jogeen/FishBook. All original credits belong to the original author.

  • ✅ Adapted for IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3.4 (build 253.x)
  • 🚀 Performance: file is now loaded into memory once via BufferedReader; page turning is O(1)
  • 📑 New: auto-detect chapters (第N章 / Chapter N / 序章 / 楔子), quick chapter jump
  • 🔖 New: remember last-read chapter
  • ⌨️ New: keyboard shortcuts (← / →) for page turning
  • 🐛 Fix: replaced deprecated APIs (ServiceManager, NotificationGroup constructor, etc.)
  • 🎨 UI: rewrote both ReadUI and SettingUI as pure code (no GUI Designer bytecode instrumentation dependency — fixes the "Select configuration element in the tree" error)
